title: How Jacky Chou makes money in SEO: affiliate rev-share partnerships, retail rank and rent, and closing the loop
summary: Jacky Chou walks through his SEO income streams for 2024. He favors affiliate revenue and rev-share partnerships with struggling funded sites, sells top placements to brands, and expects informational and display-ad traffic to die. Includes tactics for landing a first client and why he's moving toward owning products.

principles.text: Partner with funded sites that can't monetize: do the affiliate content, take a rev share on those commissions only, and piggyback their authority.
principles.quote: it's just piggybacking off of their existing Authority right because if they raise $100 million in VC funding all that spent into PR they have like a huge team before and now if they're struggling they're they're looking for ways to make money and that's where we comeing

principles.text: Once you rank a keyword, sell the top slot to brands in that category for a flat fee plus commission on top of normal affiliate revenue.
principles.quote: if we rank for best protein powder we'll go reach out to the top protein powder companies we'll be like yo pay us 20K a month we'll put you on number one and 50% commissions on top of that and it's like a no-brainer

principles.text: Start partnerships small and local. Big brands won't talk to a nobody, so use businesses you already know.
principles.quote: you should start small you can't start off with a dr90 software company doing like 10 million a year you're like no offense if you're nobody they're not going to talk to you

principles.text: Bet on commercial, trust-driven affiliate content and expect informational content and display ads to be wiped out by AI search and cookie removal.
principles.quote: I think informational content is dead is going to be dead in the next like two years so if you're relying heavily on display ads

principles.text: Against big-publisher dominance, don't compete with a niche site. Partner with the big company instead.
principles.quote: they don't like Niche sites so what do I do in response to that you partner up with one of the big companies and that's what a partnership is right so you fight fire with fire

principles.text: Land a first client by ranking something guaranteed, then pitch the business you already ranked, moving down the list if they don't pay.
principles.quote: you could do like I I've always done when I was young like rank guaranteed um and it's it's quite easy
